chapter_title: Concerning the Fifty Lord's Days; to what Mysterie
spiritual_reading:
Know that within every external truth by which the Divine good first operates in the outermost degree there is a sufficient set of interior faculties. These faculties are ordered in mutual relation, one with another, until their sufficiency is fully made complete.

When directed influx descended into the lower degree, the receptive response within the recipient simultaneously longed to rise toward its source. Directed influx together with compliant reception made a full complex of determinate qualities in a full complex of distinct forms of operation; these are the derivative powers proceeding from the Divine good in its activity with what resists it. By means of these derivative powers, directed influx and compliant reception were elevated into higher states, because these powers provided the ordered forms through which ascent could occur.

As the Divine good that engages directly with opposition elevated itself by means of these ordered operative forms, so by those same forms all higher and lower things were established and held together in their order. These constitute a full period of complete spiritual process, the archetypal pattern of all states made holy by regeneration. In that state they abstained from what is merely their own, refusing to draw life from selfhood.

From that state onward, until the coming of Divine truth in revealed glory, the nourishment of their inner life was the living provision of the soul: directed influx joined with compliant reception. Through the whole fullness of that complete process they were sustained by it, because that living nourishment was sufficient for all of them. It filled them with operative strength, with abundance of good and truth, and with spiritual vitality, and by it the understanding was illuminated and all within them was enriched.

fills.notes: The mutual ordering of the five interior powers is expressed as being “counted to each other,” matching the spiritual sense: faculties ordered in mutual relation.
The line is arithmetical: five counted in relation, and five times is their number (25). The copula best matches the completion into sufficiency.
The spiritual sense pivots on the moment of descending directed influx; this requires a temporal hinge: “at the time when the summons went down.”

Restores the clause as “who came of their food…”, i.e., the coming is characterized by the disclosure of the true inner nourishment (summons and obedience) rather than an external meal; this fits the spiritual sense of revealed Divine truth unveiling the living provision of the soul.
The spiritual sense requires the identification of the soul’s nourishment as living provision, explicitly equated with summons and obedience.
Completes the phrase “the … of soul” as “life of soul,” matching the correspondential teaching: nourishment is what sustains inner life.

Gives “They released from … all these fifty days,” i.e., abstained or loosened themselves from what is their own across the whole completed period, aligning with the fasting-from-their-own in ¶3 and the spiritual sense.
Marks extension across the whole pentecostal period: “through all these fifty days,” matching the spiritual translation’s “through the whole fullness of that complete process.”
Introduces the sufficiency clause: “for this living food suffices for all of them,” directly required by the spiritual sense.
Completes “Light … this living food that … became rich” as illumination occurring by means of that nourishment, matching: “by it the understanding was illuminated and all within them was enriched.”

assessment: Most lacunae are minor and can be restored tightly from the arithmetical structure (5×5=25) and from the correspondential identity of “food” with the living provision of the soul (summons and obedience). The harder gaps are in ¶4, where the syntax is damaged; there the spiritual constraints strongly require (1) a statement of living nourishment, (2) its sufficiency through the full fifty-day period, and (3) illumination and enrichment by means of it, but the exact connective particles remain somewhat uncertain.
